subject: Eval kickoff & trial plan — next steps
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Lucy Perez <lucy@avalabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps after discovery — evaluation kickoff and trial plan

Hi Lucy —

Thanks again for a productive discovery today. Quick recap and a proposed set of next steps so we can lock the kickoff: 

Key takeaways from our call:
- Primary objective: reduce mean time to answer for support tickets by 30% using retrieval-augmented generation for triage.
- Data scope: Zendesk exports + product docs (~10k articles), no PII to start.
- Success criteria you mentioned: intent classification recall >= 85%, and average first-response latency reduction of 30% in the pilot cohort.

Proposed evaluation kickoff (what we'll cover in the 60-min session):
1) Trial charter and timeline (we'll propose a 4-week sandbox + 4-week pilot).
2) Roles, access, and data ingest checklist.
3) Technical deep dive: sample prompts, evaluation metrics, and integration points (webhook + API).
4) Immediate next steps & calendar sync.

Ask: could you confirm a 60-minute slot next week for the kickoff and share who from your team will join (engineering, data/security, and a product owner ideally)? Also let us know if you prefer us to bring a short sample prompt pack for hands-on testing — we can share a CSV of sample prompts in advance.

I attached a one-page trial-charter that outlines timeline and responsibilities for your review.

Attachments: [trial-charter.md (text/markdown)]

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189

Subject: Re: Next steps after discovery — evaluation kickoff and trial plan

Hi Lucy — great, thanks. We can do Tue 12/1 14:00-15:00 EST. I'm proposing a calendar invite for that slot (attached as a stub) and will include a short agenda.

Quick answers to your questions:
- Sample prompt pack: I'll attach a starter CSV with 40 prompts mapped to the success metrics (intent labels + expected outputs). [Attachment: prompt-sample.csv]
- Webhook/integration: Redwood does not require inbound ports for the hosted trial; we'll use an outbound webhook delivery to your endpoint. If you prefer a private deployment we can discuss inbound/VPN later.
- Security lead: please invite them if they'd like to review data handling; our security packet (SOC 2 summary, data retention & logs) is available on request.

Calendar stub: [redwood-kickoff-invite.ics]

Agenda (60 min):
- 5m: intros & goals
- 15m: trial charter and timeline (we'll walk through responsibilities)
- 20m: technical deep dive (prompt pack, evaluation, ingest flow)
- 15m: next steps & ownership

If Tom wants a short pre-read, I'll send the prompt sample and a one-page integration diagram by end of day Friday.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Connor

--
